title: Pestilent Scar
wikitext:
[[Image:Pestilent Scar.jpg|thumb|Pestilent Scar]]
The [[Pestilent Scar]], as well as its twin [[Infectis Scar|the Infectis Scar]], are deep pitfalls that were once lakes before the coming of the [[Blight]].  Now, they are like deep scars on the land, drained of their water by the corruption of the ground around them.  If a traveler or creature is careless enough to fall into one, the fall can cause serious injury or even death.  The monstrous [[ooze]]s that fill the chasms wait for hapless prey to fall in, making for an easy meal.
